actions.action: Re-point the Queen ads from Queen White to Queen Graphite

Keywords, bids and budgets stay the same.
actions.why: Queen Graphite is the plan's Queen ad SKU. It has the deepest stock (400 units vs 197), it is the #1 Queen colour for both sister brands (Sleephoria 20%, Decolure 26% of Queen units), and the Batch 2 gate is measured on Queen Graphite's CVR. Shoppers still pick any colour on the page.
actions.evidence: This week Queen Graphite sold 3 units on 28 sessions with no ad of its own; Queen White sold 1 on 38 sessions as the ad face. That gap alone is not proof (1 of 38 happens 30% of the time), so the call rests on stock and sister-brand history.
actions.expected: Queen ad CVR moves from 4.1% toward the plan's 8–9.5%, and the Batch 2 gate (Queen Graphite CVR ≥ 7% on ≥ 100 clicks) can be read by about 3 Nov. Stock: about 250 days of cover at the plan's Queen push.
actions.check: 27 Oct: Queen CVR and Queen units/day vs the 3.0 baseline. 3 Nov: Batch 2 gate.
actions.safe: Only the product shown changes. The White ad stays paused, not deleted, and can be switched back in one step.

actions.action: Switch 'cooling sheets queen' to the ranking setup on the day the new order is dated

Proposed on the order date (model expects ~Oct 23): Ranking objective, fixed bid, Top-of-Search priced to the Queen ranking ceiling ($8.45 top-of-search price), full-day budget, as the plan's other rank exacts.

actions.expected: Queen gets King-like top-of-search delivery on its biggest search; the light-push read for Queen becomes meaningful. Plan rank path for the head: #50 → #30 → #15.
actions.check: Day 3 after the switch: top-of-search clicks ≥ 80% of goal (the plan's day-3 read). Day 7: conversion vs the market.
actions.safe: Follows Joseph's own rule (waits for the order date); only asks to apply it to Queen's head first, not all four heads.
